gloss: calm face; nonchalant look; acting as if nothing happened

definitions.gloss: calm face; nonchalant look; acting as if nothing happened
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who appears completely unaffected or unconcerned in a situation where others would be nervous, embarrassed, or troubled. Often implies the person is deliberately hiding their true feelings or pretending innocence.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}をしていた。
examples.english: He had a nonchalant look on his face.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}したのに、{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}で{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: Despite being late, he walked in looking completely unfazed.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}のミスなのに{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}をして、{他人|たにん}のせいにした。
examples.english: Even though it was his own mistake, he put on an innocent face and blamed someone else.

notes:
A figurative expression where {涼|すず}しい (cool) describes not temperature but composure. The "cool face" is one that shows no embarrassment, guilt, or worry. Often carries a slightly negative nuance — the speaker is implying the person should be more affected than they appear.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}をする: to put on a nonchalant face
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}で〜する: to do something with a calm/unbothered expression
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}をして{知|し}らんぷり: to pretend not to know with an innocent face

USAGE:
Can be used admiringly (staying cool under pressure) but more often implies criticism — the person is being too calm given the circumstances, or is deliberately feigning innocence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {知|し}らんぷり: pretending not to know — focuses on feigning ignorance
- {平然|へいぜん}と: calmly, composedly — more neutral, without the visual image of a face
- {涼|すず}しい{目|め}: cool eyes — a related expression focusing on a detached, unimpressed gaze
